Shishiku"..."
Shishiku(Achha.)
Shishiku(So this... is your doing, Chachamaru.)
Ootori Dragoon A《G-General... the Zero-Zero Types—all of them! Turning silver!》
Ootori Dragoon A《They're running wild!!》
Ootori Dragoon B《The formation... at this rate... General, what are your orders?!》
Shishiku"..."
Ootori Dragoon A《What is all this...? How did it come to this...?》
Ootori Dragoon A《Because they're new models? Some terrible defect in the CPU—》
Shishiku《No. We have simply been betrayed.》
Ootori Dragoon A《Sir?》
Shishiku(Simply betrayed. ...The same business I have been conducting all this time.)
Shishiku(Now my turn has come. That's all.)
Shishiku(Betrayal upon betrayal, murder upon murder. And at the end, I am betrayed and destroyed. Well... what else was I expecting?)
Shishiku(Even if my convictions had been spotless.)
Shishiku(I pushed my justice through and kicked aside whoever got in the way. So another justice calls me the obstruction and kicks me aside. Fair enough.)
Shishiku(In the end, who has more strength? That decides it.)
Shishiku(All my victories until now—not because I had justice. Only because I was stronger than the other fellow...)
Shishiku(If the other fellow is stronger... then I am the one betrayed, kicked aside, defeated.)
Shishiku(Hmph. And that other fellow turns out to be Chachamaru. In crookedness of character, apparently I have met my superior.)
Shishiku(No wonder I couldn't win Minato over.)
Shishiku(...)

en.html:
Shishiku(So my luck has run out.)
Ootori Dragoon B《General!》
Shishiku"..."
Ootori Dragoon B《We can't hold any longer! Give the order to retreat, sir!》
Shishiku《Retreat?》
Shishiku《To where, exactly?》
Ootori Dragoon B《This airspace is dangerous! For now, at least get clear...》
Shishiku《On the ground is my lord, His Highness Shirou Kuniuji. My people are there too, the citizens of Kamakura.》
Shishiku《Leave both behind, is that your proposal?》
Ootori Dragoon B《...B-but, sir...》
Ootori Dragoon A《General, if we don't retreat, we'll be wiped—》
Shishiku《STOP FLAPPING! Have you bloody bastards misplaced your spines?!》
Shishiku《Only winning battles you can fight?! The situation becomes a little hopeless and already your knees are resigning?!》
Shishiku《Have some shame! You call yourselves warriors of Aizu?!》
Ootori Dragoon A《————》
Shishiku《You knew this. This battle is the turning point that decides whether Yamato rises or falls.》
Shishiku《Not like six years ago—there will be NO NEXT CHANCE! Here we fight it through. Here we must win!》
Shishiku《WHATEVER HAPPENS!》
Ootori Dragoon B《General...》
Shishiku《Remember Danjou Okabe. That infuriating rebel...》
Shishiku《When we surrounded him with nowhere to go, did he surrender and beg for his life? Did he leave his retainers and run? Was that stupid old general ever so accommodating?》
Shishiku《Disgrace ourselves here, and when we meet him in hell, that bastard will laugh at us. ...Your pride can live with that, can it?》
Ootori Dragoon A《...》
Ootori Dragoon B《...》

獅子吼（命運尽きた、か）大鳥竜騎Ｂ《閣下！》獅子吼「……」大鳥竜騎Ｂ《もはやこれまで！
　撤退のご下命を！》獅子吼《撤退？》獅子吼《何処へ退くというのだ》大鳥竜騎Ｂ《この空域は危険です！
　とにかく、離脱を……》獅子吼《地上には我が主、四郎邦氏殿下がおられる。
　我が民、鎌倉の市民達もいる》獅子吼《その両方を打ち捨ててか》大鳥竜騎Ｂ《……し、しかし……》大鳥竜騎Ａ《閣下、撤退せねば全滅の――》獅子吼《狼狽うろたえるな!!
　貴様らは腑抜けかッ!!》獅子吼《勝ち戦しかできんのか!?
　たかだか戦局が絶望的になった程度で腰を
砕いてどうする!!》獅子吼《会津武士の名に恥じるがいい!!》大鳥竜騎Ａ《――――》獅子吼《わかっていたはずだぞ。
　この一戦こそ大和の浮沈を占う天王山》獅子吼《六年前とは違う――次の機会は無い！
　ここで戦い抜き、勝たなくてはならん》獅子吼《何があろうとだ！》大鳥竜騎Ｂ《閣下……》獅子吼《思い出せ。
　岡部弾正、あの忌々しい叛賊を……》獅子吼《我らに囲まれ進退窮まった時、奴は降伏し
命乞いをしたか？　家臣を捨てて逃げたか？
　そんな可愛気があの愚劣な老将にあったか》獅子吼《ここで我らが無様を晒せば、いずれ地獄で
会った折に、奴の嘲笑を買う始末となろうよ。
　……貴様らの矜持は、そんな屈辱に甘んじ
られる程度のものか？》大鳥竜騎Ａ《……》大鳥竜騎Ｂ《…………》

Shishiku"...Hmph..."
Shishiku"Luck has run out, has it? Toh? What of it?"
Shishiku"To the very end, I will do this..."
Shishiku"Giving up, regretting—no time for that now. After I die, I can attend to both."
Shishiku"While I am alive, fight and fight and fight and WIN. Bas, that is all!!"
